depth3: Conv16k5-Pool2-Drop.2 -> Conv32k5-Pool2-Drop.25 -> Conv32k3-Pool2 -> Flatten(640) -> Drop.3 -> Dense5 (no hidden Dense)

augmentation.scope: direction training sources only (not background, not validation)
augmentation.rigid_rotation_deg: uniform +-5.0, random axis, one per variant, applied to acc and gyro
augmentation.normalization: mean/std from original (unaugmented) training sources of the fold
augmentation.none_selection: baseline.choose_training over all training windows (matches positive count)

caveat: augmentation raises the number of positive windows and hence the selected NONE count; steps per epoch differ across conditions at the same E

judgement.pairing: each of B, C, D versus A, same seed and folds
judgement.metrics: per-seed sum over folds of correct events and unmatched emissions
judgement.candidate: mean correct delta >= +2 AND correct delta > 0 in >=4 of 5 seeds AND mean unmatched delta <= 0
judgement.worse: mean correct delta <= -2 AND correct delta < 0 in >=4 of 5 seeds AND mean unmatched delta >= 0
judgement.margin_basis: +-2 events is about one seed-spread sd of A at E=10 (range 13~19 in calibration)
